newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to suspend open outcry stocks trading a day.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to suspend open outcry stocks trading a day.

text.p: The Mexican Stock Exchange will take advantage of an expected dull session on Thursday to suspend open outcry trading and test an electronic trading system, traders said on Wednesday.
U.S. financial markets will be closed for Thanksgiving. U.S. market holidays usually make for minimal activity in Mexico.
The new system is called the Automated Electronic Transactions System (Sentra).

"There'll be only a few traders on the floor tomorrow, just in case," one trader said. "Dealers will trade from equity desks using the Sentra. With that and U.S. markets being closed, it'll be a very boring session."
